messages:
sophia: Heads-up: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/24680 needs to land before Friday deploy freeze. It fixes shard key handling; low-risk but CI has been flaky on mac. Who can take final review + rebase?

nate: I can take a look in ~20m. Can someone paste the failing CI line?

ci-bot: Checks summary for PR 24680 — linux: ✅ passed, mac: ❌ flaky (2/5 failures, timeout in smoke.sh), e2e: ⏳ pending. Rerun available.

anders: I reproduced the mac timeout locally — looks like the startup check sometimes hangs on our mocked KV. Quick fix is to rebase to latest main (fixes a timing flake). Rebase window per calendar is Fri 17:00-19:00 UTC but we can try for an earlier canary if needed.

maya: Can we do a canary tonight to avoid landing during the freeze window? Ops prefers no infra-touching changes after 18:00 UTC, but app-level patches ok before 20:00 with extra monitoring.

nate: OK I'll rebase now and push. Ping me if you can give eyes after I update. @sophia @maya

sophia: I can give a quick pass in 30m. If CI looks green after rebase, feel free to merge in the approved window.

nate: Rebase done and force-pushed: `git pull --rebase origin main && git push -f origin HEAD`

ci-bot: Triggered rebuild for PR 24680 — linux: ✅ passed, mac: ✅ passed, e2e: ✅ passed. All checks green.

release-manager: Thanks. I'll schedule the merge for 17:30 UTC during the rebase/merge window so we avoid the 18:00+ freeze. Tagging oncall to monitor the canary rollout.

oncall: Copy that — will watch canary for 30m post-merge and escalate if errors spike.

sophia: Great work, thanks team :rocket:

maya: Note for records — add the PR to the Friday freeze exception list (small app change, verified green).
